Package dermi.messaging.pastry

Class Summary
DirectMessage This class wraps a message addressed to a unique application in a node It is sent via a publishDirect() invocation
InterceptorDataMessage This class wraps an interception data message This kind of messages are sent when a rendezvous point change is detected
InterceptorMessage This class wraps an interceptor message.
InterceptorSubscribeMessage Message sent when willing to subscribe an interceptor to an object group
InterceptorUnsubscribeMessage Message used when willing to unsubscribe an interceptor application from an object group
MembershipMessage Message used for sending membership information to group members
